patch_description: The current program's weakest metric is smoothness (0.06), while lag error is excellent (0.22). Prior generations failed because post-smoothing was too weak. This version keeps the adaptive forward/backward Kalman fusion (which drives correlation 0.96, noise reduction 0.70, low lag) and adds a genuine zero-lag post-smoother: a two-pass forward-backward one-pole exponential smoother with α ≈ 0.5 applied to the fused signal. Running the one-pole filter forward and then on the reversed sequence cancels the phase lag a causal one-pole would introduce, so smoothing strength can be substantial without increasing lag error. A second mild forward-backward pass (α = 0.65) further damps residual ripple. Output windowing/alignment is unchanged, preserving the same I/O contract.
